$comment: IDD in-session mechanical checks — Claude Code hooks, installed per-contributor by idd-activate.sh enable claude-hooks (never by a checkout, never by install.sh). Deterministic checks only: PostToolUse runs the committed ast-grep checks against each edited file; PreToolUse runs the same checks over the tree before a git commit. No judgment review is triggered here and no review attestation is required — judgment review is manual-only (/idd-judgment-review) and advisory. Failures feed back as exit-code-2 stderr. Silent no-op when tools are missing or nothing applies, so enabling IDD never breaks a repo.

hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$f" ] || exit 0; command -v ast-grep >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; ls .github/idd/checks/*.yml >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; out=$(ast-grep scan --config sgconfig.yml "$f" 2>&1) || { printf 'IDD mechanical check failed — fix before proposing this diff:\n%s\n' "$out" >&2; exit 2; }

cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' 2>/dev/null); case "$cmd" in *'git commit'*) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; command -v ast-grep >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; ls .github/idd/checks/*.yml >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; out=$(ast-grep scan --config sgconfig.yml 2>&1) || { printf 'IDD mechanical checks failed — fix before committing:\n%s\n' "$out" >&2; exit 2; }
